data.name: Phase Party
data.detailed_description:
Play your cards. Complete your phase. Sabotage your friends. And reach the finish before everyone else.

Phase Party is a multiplayer card game that combines classic set and run-building mechanics with chaotic party gameplay.

Every player's goal is simple: Complete the phases you're given and reach the end before your opponents.

But nothing at the table goes quite as planned.

Just as another player is about to complete their phase, you can stop them, disrupt their plans, or change the course of the entire round with a well-timed action card.

COMPLETE YOUR PHASE

Each round challenges you with a different combination to complete.

Build sets of three and four, complete long number runs, match cards of the same color, and make the best possible use of the cards in your hand.

Draw the card you need.
Build your phase.
And empty your hand before your opponents.

If you fail, you'll have to attempt the same phase again in the next hand while your opponents continue to progress.

FRIENDSHIP ENDS HERE

In Phase Party, focusing only on your own hand isn't enough.

Keep an eye on what your opponents are trying to do and disrupt their plans at the right moment.

Use Hold to prevent a player from completing their phase.
Use Draw to force them to draw extra cards.

Sometimes, winning isn't just about drawing the card you need.

It's about making sure that card never reaches your friend's hand.

USE WILD CARDS WISELY

Use wild cards to complete missing combinations.

But where and when you play them matters.

A wild card can save you from a bad hand, complete a long run, or bring you back into the game just when you're about to lose.

A single card played at the right moment can shift the balance of the entire table.

ANYTHING CAN HAPPEN AT THE TABLE

This isn't an ordinary card table.

When you fail to complete your phase or the game puts you in an unexpected situation, you may find yourself facing a very different kind of problem.

A panel in front of you.
Nine buttons.
And one choice to make.

Choose the right button and you continue playing.
Choose the wrong one…

You'll discover the consequences together with your friends.

EVERY GAME BRINGS NEW CHAOS

One round, you might draw the perfect hand.

The next, everyone might be playing against you.

Just when you think you're about to win, an action card can ruin your entire plan — or a single card drawn at the last second can bring you right back into the game.

Plan your strategy.
Take risks.
Sabotage your opponents.
Push your luck.
And complete your phases before everyone else at the table.

KEY FEATURES

• A phase system built around sets, runs, and color combinations
• Chaotic multiplayer party gameplay to enjoy with friends
• Special action cards that can change the course of the game
• Wild cards that can be used in different combinations
• Add cards to phases completed by other players to empty your hand
• Strategic decisions and unexpected situations that change from hand to hand
• Sabotage mechanics that may put your friendships to the test

Good cards help in Phase Party.
But choosing the right friends might matter even more.

data.short_description: Phase Party is a chaotic card and party game where you sabotage your opponents while trying to complete your phases. Build the right combinations, use action cards, disrupt your opponents’ plans, and complete all your phases before your friends!
data.supported_languages: Turkish, English, French, German, Russian, Italian, Arabic

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 21H1 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-6100 / AMD® FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 750 Ti / AMD® Radeon™ R7 360 / Intel® UHD Graphics 630
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-8400 / AMD® Ryzen™ 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 Ti / AMD® Radeon™ RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
